# openmetadata_search_service (Resource)

Manages an OpenMetadata search service. Search services are the connection containers for search indexes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openmetadata_search_service" "elastic" {
  name         = "elastic"
  service_type = "ElasticSearch"
  display_name = "Elasticsearch"
  description  = "Search service backing the platform's index store."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Search service name. Changing it replaces the service, because the name is also its fully qualified name.
- `service_type` (String) OpenMetadata service type such as ElasticSearch, OpenSearch, CustomSearch. The server fixes it at creation, so changing it replaces the service.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Markdown description of the search service.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name shown in the OpenMetadata UI.

### Read-Only

- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name. For a search service this equals name.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC 3339 format.
- `updated_by` (String) User that performed the last update.
- `version` (Number) Server-side entity version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import openmetadata_search_service.elastic 1f6a3a52-8d34-4f4b-9d0f-2f1c1c1c1c1c

# Or import by fully qualified name, which for a search service is its name.
terraform import openmetadata_search_service.elastic elastic
```
